lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in distinct vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of high-luminance blobs to form a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light pixels above to shadowed pixels below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 small high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of linear, diagonal abrasions or scratch marks are visible on the upper mid-flank, just posterior to the head.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly clustered high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank pattern.
